Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have detailed the individual cost drivers behind your offer; it sounds like covering input costs is central to making our longstanding partnership sustainable. We want a fair, stable agreement grounded in verified index movements, with careful attention to the periods being compared. How can we balance the price adjustment and payment timing to support that shared interest?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer is a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Our pricing committee has reviewed your verified data regarding the PPI-C241 index and the increased volume forecast, enabling a corresponding adjustment to our pricing. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Extending payment terms to 90 days incurs substantial financing costs; to provide a price reduction, we must maintain our standard 30-day terms. Consequently, we propose a revised price of €368.42 per unit with 30 days net. This alternative at our standard terms is a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You link price flexibility to firmer demand and financing costs; it sounds like predictability is central to making this agreement sustainable. We want a fair adjustment that recognises your cost pressures and supports our long-term partnership. How can we reflect the recent copper movement in the price while recognising the cost of financing?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03). Our recent orders for Motor IE3 7.5 kW, 4-pole were at 348.32 per 1 (po:4500014350-20, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014474-10).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified the recent copper notation data, which reflects a minor reduction in our cost basis and allows us to adjust our pricing. 

CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. The historical purchase orders cited do not account for the substantial increases in our overall input costs over the past year. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

To support your requirement for 90-day payment terms, we propose a revised price of EUR 370.85 per unit. Our current Angebot is a price of €370.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have reflected the verified copper correction while emphasising the remaining input-cost pressures; it sounds like recognising those pressures fairly is central to an agreement. We want to support predictable cash flow and a sustainable partnership, using the latest verified labour data as an additional objective reference. How can we bring that evidence into a price that supports our continued cooperation?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 361.33 per unit, 30 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We respect that boundary and want a sustainable agreement that supports our long-term partnership. What would help us bring this to a mutually workable close?
